---
title: "Before the day"
---
The day is worked in R, inside an IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.), on a ready-made workspace that you download and check by following the setup page. The extract of the European Social Survey that the course uses ships inside the workspace, so there is nothing to register for. One file is fetched separately: the file that Multi100 gave the five analysts, which the reproduction of Task 3 needs and which the workspace downloads from the OSF the first time you ask for it. The browser lab is a demonstration of the same exercise in a browser tab: it fits no model, and shows every result as the course pipeline computed it with the code of the workspace, the reproduction included, so it gives the same numbers. The facilitator uses it on the shared screen, and if a machine fails it is the place to follow the tasks and still send both results to the class chart.

| Work through | What you do | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| [Case study](../../cases/trust/index.qmd) | The original study and its data, SCORE and the Multi100 project, the five reanalyses and what each of them held constant, the two reproductions from the survey files, the replications on later rounds, and how the results were put on one scale. Every part of the day works on this case. | 45 minutes |
| [Setup](../../setup.qmd) | Install R and an IDE, download the workspace zip and run `source("R/check_setup.R")` until it prints OK. Then, while you are online, run `source("R/spec_tools.R"); fetch_multi100()` once, which downloads the file of Task 3 (29 MB) and checks it. Open the [browser lab](../../cases/trust/lab.qmd) once as well and confirm that it loads on the machine you will use. The [help page](../../help.qmd) has the problems that other participants have met. | 30 to 60 minutes, once |
| [Positron, RStudio and VS Code](../../companion/ide.qmd) | Optional. Where the console, the variables and the data viewer are in the IDE that you chose, and what changes between the three. | 30 minutes |
| [Exercise overview](../../cases/trust/exercise.qmd) | Read the claim that you will be working on and the table of what the five Multi100 analysts found when they reanalysed it. | 10 minutes |
| [Getting started with R](../../companion/intro-r.qmd) | Optional. Worth the time if you have never written R: objects, data frames, reading a CSV file, the pipe and a first table, on the data of two other cases of the course. | An evening |

**By the start of the day** you have the workspace working on the machine that you will use, with the file of Task 3 in place, and you know what the claim is and why the five Multi100 analysts, who all found evidence for it, still reported estimates that differ by a factor of two.
